name: Claude Agent SDK
summary: A Python and TypeScript library that runs the Claude Code CLI as a subprocess, so an application can run agents with Claude Code's tools on infrastructure its owner operates.

skills.what: Agent Skills: SKILL.md folders loaded from the filesystem locations set by settingSources (TypeScript) or setting_sources (Python).

mcp.what: MCP servers that run as local processes, connect over HTTP, or run inside the SDK application.

sources.title: Connect to external tools with MCP

plugins.what: Claude Code plugins loaded from local directories, adding skills, agents, hooks and MCP servers to a session.

hooks.what: Hooks: callback functions that run on agent events such as a tool call, a session starting or execution stopping; plugins can also bring hooks.

sources.title: Intercept and control agent behavior with hooks

scheduled-work.what: The pages checked show no scheduler in the SDK itself: an application that runs prompts on its own schedule can declare each one as a scheduled run (TypeScript Agent SDK v0.3.280 or later), and cloud scheduled task deliveries arrive as task notifications.

sources.title: Agent SDK reference - TypeScript: Declare a scheduled run

sandboxes.what: The sandbox option (SandboxSettings) turns on command sandboxing with filesystem and network limits for the shell commands the agent runs; the hosting guide also covers running the SDK in containers or with sandbox providers.
